title: Photo Amendments
description: Draft public-service guidance; review questions must be resolved before publication.
clarifying_questions: Which examination and year contains the incorrect photo?
Are you applying through an institution or directly through the documented QMIS route?

claims.text: The historical manual identifies photo correction as a separate query.

The September 2017 guide shows selecting Photo Amendment, entering the examination identity directly in QMIS, selecting examination, year and series, using Find to display the current photo, uploading the proposed correct photo, attaching each document requested by the Required List and submitting.
The 2018 guide says to confirm captured details and attachments, submit, check the success feedback and later use Status to monitor the query; it does not define every current status label.

The historical screen requires the applicant to select documents from a Required List, but the guide does not establish a universal current attachment checklist, fee, deadline or authorized-requester rule for photo amendments.

unresolved_questions: Confirm current eligibility, authorized requester, photo specification and attachment checklist.
Confirm live QMIS applicability and any examination-specific deadline or charge.
Keep photo amendment separate from other biodata corrections.
